categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies peer eviction logic and connection management in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Improves transaction relay topology by ensuring outbound full-relay slots are not occupied by peers that decline transaction relay. Addresses longstanding network health issues (#16418, #28371) where nodes could be left with too few transaction-relaying outbound connections.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Test modifications are domain-specific tests for p2p outbound eviction rather than improvements to test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: The functional test and test framework updates directly verify p2p eviction behavior and do not constitute changes to generic test machinery.
